title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
description:
TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents.

title: Google Cloud Launches Agent Compute Engine: A MicroVM per AI Agent
description:
Google Cloud announced Agent Compute Engine, a compute service that gives every AI agent its own hardware-isolated microVM with no credentials inside. It already runs Gemini agents and enters preview in the coming months.
